Nocturne Character Edition 05

Original character meshes, skeleton layout, costumes and GLB authoring: this Nocturne project.
Concept and portrait textures: original project concept art (Art Edition 04).

Base animation source: Kay Lousberg / KayKit Game Assets, KayKit Character Pack Adventures 1.0, CC0 1.0.
https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers
https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0
Source file: addons/kaykit_character_pack_adventures/Characters/gltf/Knight.glb
Animations sampled and retargeted to new Nocturne proportions; secondary cloth motion added. No KayKit character geometry is included in the three Nocturne GLBs.

Rebuild from project root: node character-source-v5/build.mjs
Included reference-motion.json contains sampled reference motion; first-time extraction can be reproduced by passing the official Knight.glb to build.mjs when that cache is absent.
